description: Openly licensed photographs of residential spaces, one per item, each labelled with the room type a listing agent would accept unchanged, for SC-002 (room classification accepted without change for at least 90% of photos). Covers every room type in photo.analysis v2's roomType enum, mixing staged listing-style shots with lived-in, historic, low-light, cropped and unusual examples. Items marked labelConfidence 'ambiguous' are photos where another room type is defensible; they are scored like every other item (see PhotoEval). The image files are not committed: each item names its source, license and SHA-256, and 'aieval --fetch-eval-sets' downloads and verifies them into a local cache.

provenance.source: Wikimedia Commons file pages, plus Flickr and StockSnap photo pages (providers indexed by Openverse), collected by AI research agents on 2026-11-16. Each item records its source page and the exact file URL that was downloaded and hashed.
provenance.rights: Each item records its own license and license URL: CC0 1.0, CC BY 2.0/2.5/3.0/4.0, or a public-domain status stated on the Commons file page (PD-self, PD-user, US federal government works, PD-Highsmith, PD-old-70-expired, PD-anon-expired, PD-1923, PD-Australia, PD-Canada, HABS). Used for internal model evaluation only and never republished by the product; the files are fetched from their sources, not redistributed from this repository. CC BY attribution is in ATTRIBUTION.md beside this manifest.
provenance.labellingMethod: One label per photo from photo.analysis v2's roomType enum: the room type an agent would accept without change for a listing photo. The labeller read the source page's title and description and looked at the image. labelConfidence is 'clear' when one room type is evident, and 'ambiguous' when another is defensible; the notes say which and why. 'primary_bedroom' was given only where the uploader called the room the master or primary bedroom; most of those are marked ambiguous because nothing visible separates them from a secondary bedroom. No second labeller; no adjudication has taken place.

review.notes: Labelled by AI research agents and NOT reviewed. Before marking reviewed, a person should: (1) look at every photo after 'aieval --fetch-eval-sets' and confirm or change each label, paying most attention to the ambiguous items and to primary_bedroom versus bedroom, where the label often rests on the uploader's title rather than on anything visible; (2) decide whether ambiguous items stay in the set as scored items (the default, which can only lower the measured rate), are relabelled, or are removed in a new version; (3) confirm each license against its source page, including that the public-domain items (Commons PD-* and HABS tags, which are public-domain statuses rather than the literal PDM 1.0 mark) are acceptable for this use. Changing any item means a new version of the set.
